name: accordion-find-in-page
title: Accordion: Find in page
description: Search for “workspace recovery” using your browser's Find command. With `hiddenUntilFound`, supporting browsers reveal and open the matching panel. The panel remains collapsed until the user opens it or browser search finds a match. The disabled section demonstrates native disabled trigger behavior.

files.content:
import { Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent, } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/accordion"; const FindInPageExample = () => (

Use browser Find to search for “workspace recovery”. Matching a closed panel reveals its content in browsers that support hidden-until-found.

How do I restore my workspace? Workspace recovery restores your saved projects and preferences. Review the restored project before continuing your work. How do I share a project? Invite a teammate from the project actions menu and choose the appropriate access. Managed by your organization This setting is unavailable.
); export default FindInPageExample;
